style: Hand-painted 2.5D storybook animated film for Korean elementary-school children. Keep the exact art style, colours, lighting and character designs of the frames: the explorer child (olive-green bucket hat, teal shirt, tan vest, olive backpack), Ipsae the leaf-green parrot with a light-blue neckerchief, Mul-bang-ul the brown river otter with a light-blue neckerchief and gold water-drop charm, and the small comical villain with an orange megaphone head and purple body. Birds always fly with feathered wings, the otter moves like an otter. Funny and hopeful, never scary, nobody is hurt.
rules: One continuous shot, no cuts. No voices, no speech, no music. No subtitles, captions, logos or any written text anywhere.

clips.prompt: Dusk inside the round climate research lab. The wall screens flicker and dim one by one; blank record cards swirl out of the open window into the violet sky. The parrot flaps its wings in surprise, the otter leaps and catches one card and hugs it. Far away on the hill the tiny villain scurries off and the observatory lights blink out. Then the camera turns smoothly back into the lab as desk lamps warm up and the explorer child walks in to the big round map table with the parrot landing on the child's shoulder and the otter climbing onto a stool, ending exactly on the final frame.
clips.audio: Audio: soft wind gust, fluttering paper, a gentle electrical fizz, then calm room tone and footsteps.

clips.prompt: At the lamp-lit map table, the child lowers the magnifying glass and studies the map; the five floating glass medallions glow faintly one after another from left to right while the otter taps the map and the parrot tilts its head. The camera then dives gently down into the illustrated paper map, and the painted valley on the paper comes alive and opens into the real valley at early dawn, mist rising, ending exactly on the final frame high above the valley with the three small figures on the path.
clips.audio: Audio: page rustle, five tiny chime sparkles, a soft magical whoosh into morning birdsong.

clips.prompt: Early dawn over the valley. The camera cranes up and glides slowly along the winding path from the round research base toward the city studio on the right. The three small figures walk out along the path; a soft golden trail of light travels ahead of them along the path and touches each of the five dark buildings in turn with a brief sparkle while the buildings stay dark; dawn brightens, mist drifts, birds cross the sky.
clips.audio: Audio: morning birdsong, light breeze, distant river.

clips.prompt: Golden sunset over the same valley. The windows of the five buildings light up one by one from left to right with a soft warm bloom; a ribbon of record cards flows through the sky back into the round research base; the little villain shrugs, waves sheepishly and hops away. The child, parrot and otter cheer. Then the camera flies smoothly toward the glowing base and in through its big panoramic window into the warm operations room, ending exactly on the final frame of the celebration inside.
clips.audio: Audio: five gentle rising chimes, paper whoosh, evening birds, then warm room tone.

clips.prompt: Inside the operations room at night. Golden light travels around the ring of five medallions on the big screen and pulses; the gold stamp on the child's certificate sparkles; the parrot bobs, the otter claps and bounces, leaf-shaped confetti drifts. The golden glow then brightens softly to fill the frame like sunrise and gently reveals the next morning on a green neighbourhood street near a school, ending exactly on the final frame.
clips.audio: Audio: a warm rising chime, soft paw claps, a gentle shimmer into morning birdsong.

clips.prompt: A sunny morning on a tree-shaded street near a school. Smooth side tracking shot following the child, who walks and takes a sip from a reusable water bottle; in the classroom window a classmate switches off the lamp; the otter waves from the rain garden; the parrot glides alongside and loops once; leaves sway; at the end the camera tilts gently up to the bright blue sky.
clips.audio: Audio: morning birds, light breeze, footsteps, distant playground ambience without words.
